messages.author: 051b8654c3457b56
messages.subject: Arbitrary extra y-axis?
parts:
Hi,

Is there a way to add an arbitrary y-axis on the right side of the
plot in ggplot2?

I was working with data where the y variable has a representation in
another type of units, and it would be nice to have the other y-axis
be labeled to represent this, so readers can interpret it in either
way. An example is attached (from
http://acl.ldc.upenn.edu/D/D07/D07-1090.pdf )

I guess I know how to do this in base graphics, but that's no fun :)

Brendan
